data.one_liner: Dart port of Preact.js Signals for fine-grained reactive state management.
data.what_it_does: Provides core reactive primitives like signals, computed values, and effects for managing application state. Automatically tracks dependencies and updates UI or business logic precisely without manual listeners.
use_when: You want fine-grained reactivity without boilerplate.
You prefer signals over traditional widget-tree state management.
You are porting or matching an architecture that uses Preact signals.
avoid_when: Your project standardizes entirely around Riverpod, Bloc, or Provider.
You want automatic widget-tree rebuilding integrated directly out of the box without additional bindings.
strengths: Fine-grained updates without rebuilding entire widget subtrees
Direct Dart port of a mature and proven JS signals library
weaknesses: Relatively niche ecosystem in Flutter compared to Riverpod or Bloc
Not documented with explicit built-in Flutter widget binding helpers in the provided text

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: More robust ecosystem and standard for Flutter state management.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Predictable event-driven architecture with strong testing utilities.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler context-based inheritance model built into the Flutter ecosystem.
